panels.title: Baseline ($baseline_branch) vs Current ($current_branch), сценарий $scenario, clients=$clients — берётся ПОСЛЕДНИЙ записанный прогон каждой ветки (см. record_run.sh)
Baseline vs Current — по метрикам
panels.description: Один прогон на ветку (последний по ts), уровень concurrency = $clients. degradation_pct > 0 — хуже baseline, независимо от того, что именно измеряет строка (для RPS уже инвертировано: падение throughput тоже даёт положительный % деградации, тот же принцип, что item 6 в исходном запросе).

targets.rawSql:
WITH baseline_run AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$baseline_branch' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     current_run  AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$current_branch'  AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     b AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM baseline_run) AND clients = $clients),
     c AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM current_run)  AND clients = $clients),
     metrics(metric, baseline, current, lower_is_better) AS (
       VALUES
         ('p50 latency, мс', (SELECT p50_ms FROM b), (SELECT p50_ms FROM c), true),
         ('p90 latency, мс', (SELECT p90_ms FROM b), (SELECT p90_ms FROM c), true),
         ('p95 latency, мс', (SELECT p95_ms FROM b), (SELECT p95_ms FROM c), true),
         ('p99 latency, мс', (SELECT p99_ms FROM b), (SELECT p99_ms FROM c), true),
         ('RPS', (SELECT rps FROM b), (SELECT rps FROM c), false),
         ('Error rate, %', (SELECT error_rate * 100 FROM b), (SELECT error_rate * 100 FROM c), true),
         ('CPU, %', (SELECT avg_cpu_pct FROM b), (SELECT avg_cpu_pct FROM c), true),
         ('Memory, MB', (SELECT avg_mem_bytes / 1048576.0 FROM b), (SELECT avg_mem_bytes / 1048576.0 FROM c), true),
         ('DB active conns (reports_pool)', (SELECT avg_pg_active_conns FROM b), (SELECT avg_pg_active_conns FROM c), true),
         ('DB cache hit, %', (SELECT avg_pg_cache_hit_pct FROM b), (SELECT avg_pg_cache_hit_pct FROM c), false),
         ('DB lock waits', (SELECT avg_pg_lock_waits FROM b), (SELECT avg_pg_lock_waits FROM c), true)
     )
SELECT
  metric,
  round(baseline::numeric, 2) AS baseline,
  round(current::numeric, 2) AS current,
  CASE WHEN baseline IS NULL OR baseline = 0 OR current IS NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN lower_is_better THEN round(((current - baseline) / baseline * 100)::numeric, 1)
       ELSE round(((baseline - current) / baseline * 100)::numeric, 1)
  END AS degradation_pct
FROM metrics;

panels.title: Performance Score
panels.description: Эвристическая сводка (100 − среднее по 5 компонентам деградации, каждый обрезан до [0,100]) — см. комментарий в самом запросе. НЕ замена реальным метрикам слева, только ориентир "в целом лучше/хуже".

targets.rawSql:
WITH baseline_run AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$baseline_branch' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     current_run  AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$current_branch'  AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     b AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM baseline_run) AND clients = $clients),
     c AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM current_run)  AND clients = $clients),
     comps AS (
       SELECT
         LEAST(GREATEST(CASE WHEN b.p95_ms IS NULL OR b.p95_ms = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (c.p95_ms - b.p95_ms) / b.p95_ms * 100 END, 0), 100) AS c1,
         LEAST(GREATEST(CASE WHEN b.rps IS NULL OR b.rps = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (b.rps - c.rps) / b.rps * 100 END, 0), 100) AS c2,
         LEAST(GREATEST(CASE WHEN b.error_rate = 0 AND c.error_rate = 0 THEN 0 WHEN b.error_rate = 0 THEN 100 ELSE (c.error_rate - b.error_rate) / b.error_rate * 100 END, 0), 100) AS c3,
         LEAST(GREATEST(CASE WHEN b.avg_cpu_pct IS NULL OR b.avg_cpu_pct = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (c.avg_cpu_pct - b.avg_cpu_pct) / b.avg_cpu_pct * 100 END, 0), 100) AS c4,
         LEAST(GREATEST(CASE WHEN b.avg_mem_bytes IS NULL OR b.avg_mem_bytes = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (c.avg_mem_bytes - b.avg_mem_bytes)::numeric / b.avg_mem_bytes * 100 END, 0), 100) AS c5
       FROM b, c
     )
SELECT GREATEST(0, round((100 - (c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5) / 5.0)::numeric, 0)) AS score FROM comps;

WITH baseline_run AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$baseline_branch' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     current_run  AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$current_branch'  AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     b AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM baseline_run) AND clients = $clients),
     c AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM current_run)  AND clients = $clients)
SELECT round((CASE WHEN b.p95_ms IS NULL OR b.p95_ms = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (c.p95_ms - b.p95_ms) / b.p95_ms * 100 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Latency" FROM b, c;

WITH baseline_run AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$baseline_branch' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     current_run  AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$current_branch'  AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     b AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM baseline_run) AND clients = $clients),
     c AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM current_run)  AND clients = $clients)
SELECT round((CASE WHEN b.rps IS NULL OR b.rps = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (b.rps - c.rps) / b.rps * 100 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Throughput" FROM b, c;

WITH baseline_run AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$baseline_branch' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     current_run  AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$current_branch'  AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     b AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM baseline_run) AND clients = $clients),
     c AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM current_run)  AND clients = $clients)
SELECT round((CASE WHEN b.error_rate = 0 AND c.error_rate = 0 THEN 0 WHEN b.error_rate = 0 THEN 100 ELSE (c.error_rate - b.error_rate) / b.error_rate * 100 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Errors" FROM b, c;

panels.title: p95 latency: baseline vs current
panels.description: По одной группе столбцов на уровень concurrency — baseline (последний прогон $baseline_branch) и current (последний прогон $current_branch), сценарий $scenario. Числа те же, что и в таблице ниже.

targets.rawSql:
WITH baseline_run AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$baseline_branch' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     current_run  AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$current_branch'  AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     b AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM baseline_run)),
     c AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM current_run))
SELECT COALESCE(b.clients, c.clients) AS clients, b.p95_ms AS baseline, c.p95_ms AS current
FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c ON b.clients = c.clients
ORDER BY clients;

panels.title: Degradation, % (p95, current относительно baseline)
panels.description: degradation = (current_p95 - baseline_p95) / baseline_p95 * 100 — положительное = хуже baseline (см. item 6 исходного запроса).

targets.rawSql:
WITH baseline_run AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$baseline_branch' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     current_run  AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$current_branch'  AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     b AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM baseline_run)),
     c AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM current_run))
SELECT COALESCE(b.clients, c.clients) AS clients,
       CASE WHEN b.p95_ms IS NULL OR b.p95_ms = 0 OR c.p95_ms IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE round(((c.p95_ms - b.p95_ms) / b.p95_ms * 100)::numeric, 1) END AS degradation_pct
FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c ON b.clients = c.clients
ORDER BY clients;

panels.title: Sweep — таблица (все метрики, все уровни)
panels.description: То же, что два графика выше, но числами и по всем метрикам сразу — если barchart не отрисуется как ожидается (панель довольно новая в версии Grafana), эта таблица — надёжный фолбэк с теми же данными.

targets.rawSql:
WITH baseline_run AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$baseline_branch' AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     current_run  AS (SELECT id FROM test_run WHERE branch = '$current_branch'  AND scenario = '$scenario' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1),
     b AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM baseline_run)),
     c AS (SELECT * FROM test_result WHERE test_run_id = (SELECT id FROM current_run))
SELECT COALESCE(b.clients, c.clients) AS clients,
       b.p95_ms AS baseline_p95, c.p95_ms AS current_p95,
       b.rps AS baseline_rps, c.rps AS current_rps,
       round((b.error_rate * 100)::numeric, 3) AS baseline_err_pct, round((c.error_rate * 100)::numeric, 3) AS current_err_pct
FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c ON b.clients = c.clients
ORDER BY clients;

panels.title: Все записанные прогоны
panels.description: Плоский список — commit/branch/clients/p95/RPS/errors по всем прогонам сценария $scenario, самые новые сверху (см. item 3 исходного запроса).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tr.ts AS "time", tr.commit_sha, tr.branch, tres.clients,
       tres.p95_ms, tres.rps, round((tres.error_rate * 100)::numeric, 3) AS error_pct,
       tres.avg_cpu_pct, round((tres.avg_mem_bytes / 1048576.0)::numeric, 1) AS avg_mem_mb,
       tres.avg_pg_active_conns, round(tres.avg_pg_cache_hit_pct::numeric, 1) AS avg_pg_cache_hit_pct, tres.avg_pg_lock_waits
FROM test_result tres
JOIN test_run tr ON tr.id = tres.test_run_id
WHERE tr.scenario = '$scenario'
ORDER BY tr.ts DESC, tres.clients ASC
LIMIT 200;
